questions.question: What was Hezekiah's first major act as king?
options: Reopening and cleansing the LORD's temple
Raising heavy taxes across the kingdom
Building a new palace of cedar wood
Marching out to war against Assyria
questions.answer: Reopening and cleansing the LORD's temple
